sources.method: Live poe.ninja paper-doll tooltips were hovered and read from role=tooltip innerText on both the English and zh-tw pages. Tooltip color categories were taken from CSS variables in the tooltip HTML (not guessed). Weapon set I and II tabs were clicked on both left (main-hand) and right (off-hand) sides. Socketed augment icons were hovered separately. No item, name, base, or affix was invented.

tooltip_conventions.prefix_vs_suffix: The poe.ninja tooltip does not label affixes as Prefix or Suffix. That distinction is recorded as null.
